year.sort: from the oldest to the newest
year.era: Drop each painting into the century it was painted.

artist.match: Match each painting to the artist who painted it.

rows.label: Mona Lisa
rows.description: oil painting by Leonardo da Vinci in the Louvre, Paris
rows.hook: shows a poised woman with a faint, ambiguous smile against a hazy landscape backdrop

rows.label: The Starry Night
rows.hook: shows a swirling sky of glowing stars over a quiet village and a tall dark cypress tree

rows.label: The Garden of Earthly Delights
rows.description: medieval triptych by Hieronymus Bosch, Prado
rows.hook: depicts a fantastical triptych of paradise, chaotic pleasure, and nightmarish punishment across three panels

rows.label: Girl with a Pearl Earring
rows.hook: shows a young woman in a blue turban glancing over her shoulder with a luminous teardrop jewel at her ear

rows.label: The Birth of Venus
rows.hook: shows a goddess emerging from the sea standing on a giant scallop shell

rows.label: Arnolfini Portrait
rows.hook: shows a wealthy merchant couple holding hands in a bedroom, a small dog at their feet and a mirror behind them

rows.label: Las Meninas
rows.hook: shows a royal court scene where the artist appears at his easel beside a young princess and her attendants

rows.label: The Night Watch
rows.hook: shows a militia company bursting into motion as their captain gives the order to march

rows.label: Lady with an Ermine
rows.description: painting by Leonardo da Vinci from around 1489–1490
rows.hook: shows a young noblewoman cradling a sleek white weasel-like animal in her arms

rows.label: Wanderer above the Sea of Fog
rows.description: painting by Caspar David Friedrich at the Hamburger Kunsthalle
rows.hook: shows a lone figure standing atop a rocky peak gazing out over a mist-filled valley

rows.label: The Raft of the Medusa
rows.hook: shows shipwreck survivors crowded on a makeshift vessel desperately signaling a distant ship

rows.label: Liberty Leading the People
rows.hook: shows a bare-chested allegorical woman waving a flag as she charges over fallen bodies during an uprising

rows.label: Impression, Sunrise
rows.hook: shows a hazy harbor at dawn with small boats silhouetted against an orange sun

rows.label: The Death of Socrates
rows.hook: shows a condemned philosopher calmly reaching for a cup of poison surrounded by grieving followers

rows.label: The Third of May 1808
rows.hook: shows a peasant with arms raised facing an execution squad by lantern light

rows.label: Primavera
rows.hook: shows mythological figures dancing together in an orange grove to welcome the arrival of spring
